hebrewText: וְ/כִֽי יָג֨וּר אִתְּ/כֶ֜ם גֵּ֗ר וְ/עָ֤שָֽׂה פֶ֨סַח֙ לַֽ/יהוָ֔ה כְּ/חֻקַּ֥ת הַ/פֶּ֛סַח וּ/כְ/מִשְׁפָּט֖/וֹ כֵּ֣ן יַעֲשֶׂ֑ה חֻקָּ֤ה אַחַת֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה לָ/כֶ֔ם וְ/לַ/גֵּ֖ר וּ/לְ/אֶזְרַ֥ח הָ/אָֽרֶץ

tokens.bdb: properly, to turn aside from the road (for a lodging or any other purpose), i.e. sojourn (as a guest); also to shrink, fear (as in a strange place); also to gather forhostility (as afraid)
tokens.kjv: abide, assemble, be afraid, dwell, fear, gather (together), inhabitant, remain, sojourn, stand in awe, (be) stranger, [idiom] surely.

tokens.bdb: properly, nearness (used only as a preposition or an adverb), near; hence, generally, with, by, at, among, etc.
tokens.kjv: against, among, before, by, for, from, in(-to), (out) of, with. Often with another prepositional prefix.

properly, a verdict (favorable or unfavorable) pronounced judicially, especially a sentence or formal decree (human or (participant's) divine law, individual or collective), including the act, the place, the suit, the crime, and the penalty; abstractly, justice, including a participant's right or privilege (statutory or customary), or even a style
